content: Ta ayco janma yin̈ Comam Dios chonkꞌoji yin̈ sunil istxꞌojal
Mac chianayto yul yanma tato haꞌ Comam Jesús, haꞌ Cristo Cocolomal, caw yuninal Comam Dios yehi. Tato chijoche Comam Dios chijochepaxo Iscꞌahol Comam.
Hayet chijochen Comam Dios, cat xin coyijen tzet chala, caw johtaj tato caw chicoxahann̈e sunil yuninal Comam.
Tato chicoyije cuybanile aycano jet yu Comam, haꞌ chalniloj ta chijoche Comam. Sunil cuybanile yet Comam tuꞌ mach yaꞌtajo coyijeni.
Yuxin sunil yuninal Comam Dios, chikꞌoji yin̈ sunil istxꞌojal ay yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ, yuto yet chijanico janma yin̈ Comam Dios chon̈kꞌoji yin̈ istxꞌojal ay yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ.
Haꞌ mac chianayto yul yanma tato haꞌ Comam Jesucristo caw Iscꞌahol Comam Dios yehi, chikꞌoji yin̈ sunil istxꞌojal ay yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ.
Oxeb tzet chiyeniloj tato iscꞌahol Comam Dios ye Comam Jesús

Yet yulicꞌo Comam Jesucristo yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ, ah haꞌ iswiꞌ, yelpaxo ischiqꞌuil, haꞌ ton xin chiyeniloj tato Iscꞌahol Comam Dios yehi. Mach ton̈eho hulicꞌo yakꞌaꞌ aho haꞌ iswiꞌ, to elpaxo ischiqꞌuil yet iscami.

Ay ox majan chakꞌ isba yin̈ ta haꞌ Comam Jesucristo caw Iscꞌahol Comam Dios yehi; haꞌ Comam Espíritu Santo ay yiban̈ yet yah haꞌ iswiꞌ Comam, istzotelayti Comam Dios yiban̈, istzotelpaxo Comam Dios yet lan̈an iscam Comam yin̈ culus.
Hacaꞌticꞌa yalni Comam Espíritu Santo yin̈ Comam Jesucristo, hac tuꞌ xin yu isyenipaxo ha haꞌ, yeb chicꞌ.
Chijabeto yin̈ tzet chal comon anma, hajxam xin yin̈ tzet chal Comam Dios, to caw ecꞌbalto ay yelapno ye tzet chal Comam, wal xin haꞌ caw Comam Dios chitzotel yin̈ Iscꞌahol.

Mac chianayto yul yanma yin̈ Comam Dios, lan̈an yalni Comam Espíritu Santo yul yanma tato yel chal Comam yin̈ Iscꞌahol. Wal mac mach chianayto yul yanma yin̈ Comam Dios xin, caw lekꞌtiꞌ Comam yul sat, yuto mach chiyayto yul yanma yin̈ tzet chiyal Comam Dios yin̈ Iscꞌahol.
Huneꞌ tzet chal Comam Dios, haꞌ ton cokꞌinal mach istan̈bal chakꞌ Comam; caw xin yin̈n̈e Iscꞌahol Comam ay huneꞌ kꞌinale tuꞌ.
Yuxin haꞌ mac xaischah Iscꞌahol Comam Dios yul yanma, caw ay huneꞌ iskꞌinal mach chitan̈i. Yaj wal mac machi Iscꞌahol Comam yul yanma xin, machi huneꞌ iskꞌinal tuꞌ.
Caw johtaj tato ay huneꞌ cokꞌinal mach istan̈bal
Hex chahbilxa Iscꞌahol Comam heyu, chintzꞌibn̈etojan huneꞌ carta tiꞌ teyet yun̈e heyohtan̈eniloj tato ay hekꞌinal mach istan̈bal.
Yuxin chicawxi incꞌulan yin̈ Comam Dios, yuto johtaj ta chicokꞌan hunu tzet ye tuꞌ tet Comam hacaꞌ tzet choche iscꞌul Comam, caw chabe Comam tzet chicokꞌana.
Yuxin ta caw johtaj tato caw chabe Comam Dios tzet chijala yet chon̈txahli tet Comam, caw johtapaxoj tato chiyakꞌ Comam tzet chicokꞌana.

Tato chijila ta ay hunu juẍta ayco yin̈ mule, yaj mule mach chon̈yito yin̈ camical mach istan̈bal, cokꞌanawe iscꞌulal iscꞌul Comam Dios yin̈ naj, cat xin yakꞌni Comam iscawil naj. Wal xin ay huneꞌxa mule chon̈inito yul iskꞌab huneꞌ camical mach istan̈bal. Tato yin̈ huneꞌ mule tuꞌ bay ayco juẍtaj maca janab, caw chiwalan teyet mach chekꞌan iscꞌulal Comam Dios yiban̈, mach chiwalan teyet ta chextxahli yin̈.
Sunil ismachiswalilal haꞌ ton mule, yaj ay mule mach chon̈inito yin̈ camical.
Caw johtaj ta macta yuninalxa Comam Dios yehi, matxa chaco ismul, yuto haxa Iscꞌahol Comam Dios chitan̈eni. Yuxin caw matxa chu yoc naj matzwalil yetanoj.
Caw johtaj ta yeton̈xa Comam Dios. Wal anma yet yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ, caw ayayo yalan̈ yip naj matzwalil.

Caw johtapaxoj tato xahulicꞌo Iscꞌahol Comam Dios, haꞌ Comam akꞌn̈e conabal johtan̈enilo Comam Dios yin̈ caw isyelal. Yuxinto hunxa je yin̈ Comam caw yel chala, haꞌ ton Comam Jesucristo, Iscꞌahol Comam Dios yehi, haꞌ Comam Dios yin̈ caw isyelal, haꞌ Comam chiakꞌni cokꞌinal mach istan̈bal.
Hex xahan ay wutiꞌan, caw nann̈e heyu, mach chexoc tzujno yinta tioẍ yeb sunil huntekꞌan bay chiay jahno anma. ¡Hacojab tuꞌ!
